milestone_brief:
Contract v1 schemas and the mfc validate/lint-schemas subcommands.

Create arXMCP/contract/ per bridgeland-stab-lean ADR-0007: the seven JSON Schema 2020-12 documents (emission, environment, declarations, review, build, bundle, resolution) with additionalProperties:false throughout, plus the mfc CLI subcommands validate and lint-schemas.

lint-schemas is the load-bearing one: it rejects any schema defining a property named status/verified/ok/passed/trusted/result, which converts arXMCP CLAUDE.md 4.9 trust-language policy from a review habit into a machine constraint.

Schemas are copy-pasteable from bridgeland-stab-lean .claude/notes/2026-08-04-contract-schemas.md. Rule 7 of the bridge-contract system means mfc is an arXMCP-side CLI only; topic repos vendor schema copies with a checksum-drift test.

Tracks bridgeland-stab-lean issues #19 and #21 (epic contract-v1-e3).
